text.en:
Upon finishing a reload within 3.8 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
17% | 33% | 50% Increased damage for 5 seconds, depending on the amount of enemies killed within [?] seconds of each.

Buff is overwritten every time you refresh it.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased to 5.5 seconds.
)
text.zh-chs:
击杀后 3.8 秒内换弹：
根据 [?] 秒内的击杀数量，增加 17% | 33% | 50% 伤害，持续 5 秒。

增益可以被刷新。

enhanced (
#e 增益持续时间增加到 5.5 秒。
)

text.en:
Upon finishing a reload within 3.8 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
17% | 33% | 50% Increased damage for #e${5+#d} seconds, depending on the amount of enemies killed within [?] seconds of each.

Each kill within the time period contributes to 1 Stack of the buff. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Buff is overwritten every time it is refreshed.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
)
